description: Selected turbine model from the library (or "custom" for an uploaded power curve)
Height the wind-speed dataset is referenced to (NASA POWER / the bundled default both report at 10m)
Selected turbine's hub height — used to shear-correct the reference-height wind speed up to the rotor
Wind-shear power-law exponent (v(hub) = v(ref) x (hub_height/reference_height)^alpha) — 0.14 is typical for open/coastal terrain
